Read all 104 lines of dat/Val-goal.lua, SHA256 b9954f089233af5a4566def70b20cb4fd58e38125ec7ee5469d0ba116ae78f92. It performs solid fill lava; mazelevel and icedpools flags; mines style floor over lava background with smoothed/joined/lit settings; and a literal transparent 35x17 map. The local 0,0..34,16 region is lit. Preserve transparent x cells and the procedural terrain beneath them.

Lines 34-39 intentionally place the up stair beyond the map: replace lava with floor in relative rectangle 44,9..46,11 at chance 50, then request the up stair at 45,10. Existing lspo_replace_terrain converts the rectangle and visits it x-major, drawing rn2(100) only for matching lava cells. Existing lspo_stair and normal stair owners retain the off-map coordinate semantics. The non-diggable selection covers only local 0,0..34,16.

Lines 42-47 create a northern bridge at 17,2 facing south in random state, then use percent(75) to choose a southern bridge at 17,14 facing north, open on success and random otherwise. The Lua helper consumes rn2(100); the northern random-state draw precedes the percentage draw. Existing lspo_drawbridge and create_drawbridge handle the random-state roll, bridge orientation, and lava underlay; both conditional arms must preserve source order.

Lines 49-63 place a blessed +5 crystal ball named The Orb of Fate at 17,8 followed by fourteen random objects. Lines 65-74 place board traps at 13,8 and 21,8, four random fire traps, a random board trap, and two random traps. Existing object and artifact naming uses ONAME_LEVEL_DEF; no additional object owner is required.

Lines 76-95 create Lord Surtur at 17,8; four fire ants; two source string-id a-class monsters; ten fixed hostile fire giants at local x=10/24 and y=6..10; two random hostile fire giants; and one hostile H-class monster. Preserve all 20 descriptor calls and their name/class lookup and placement RNG order.

Production wiring is a distinct Val-goal import/body/QUEST_LEVEL_LOADERS key in js/quest_levels.js. The production paths are mklev.c:makelevel -> mkmaze.c:makemaz -> sp_lev.c:load_special -> dat/Val-goal.lua and wizcmds.c:wiz_load_splua -> load_special -> registered Val-goal. Existing level, transparent-map, replacement, stair, drawbridge, artifact, trap, and monster owners cover the source calls; no generic descriptor-owner or shared contract change is identified.
